Unimoni Student Star Scholarship 2023 is an opportunity provided by the Unimoni Financial Services Limited* for Class 10 passed to graduate Indian students to help them financially. The selected students will receive up to INR 3 lakh and other exciting prizes (one-time).

*Unimoni Financial Services Limited, formerly known as UAE Exchange, is part of Finablr, a global platform for Payments and Foreign Exchange solutions. The organization deals with money transfers, forex, payments, and credit solutions.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
hold a valid offer letter from the university (if studying abroad)
have scored above 60% marks in Classes 10, 12, diploma, or graduation from a recognised school/university
Indian students studying at overseas universities at any level of education can also apply for the scholarship.
The selected candidate will receive the benefits in the following manner:
INR 3 lakh and an HP ChromeBook
INR 1.5 lakh and a trolley bag
Offer letter received from the university
